name: Illinois Supply Company
old_description: Illinois Supply Company was founded with the creation of the Original Allergy Emergency Kit that is now in thousands of schools around the world.
about:
Illinois Supply Company operates from Mokena, Illinois, and was founded with the creation of the Original Allergy Emergency Kit, a product now deployed in thousands of schools worldwide. The company is owned by Brandon Wilson, who also designed the original Overdose Emergency Kit that established the Naloxone Box category in 2014.

The company manufactures a range of emergency medical and harm reduction equipment, including naloxone cabinets, boxes, vending machines (such as the Barney freestanding kiosk), overdose emergency cabinets, and police pouches. It also produces epinephrine storage cabinets, Allergy Emergency Kits (AEK), school nurse storage panels, LiveSafer safety stations, AED cabinets, and bleeding control, asthma, and choking response kits. In 2024, the firm tripled its manufacturing and warehouse space to meet growing demand, and it emphasizes made-to-order production with ship-on-demand fulfillment for grant-funded programs.

Illinois Supply Company serves non-profit agencies, community health departments, school districts, correctional facilities, law enforcement, and state and county public health departments. Concrete clients include the Florida Department of Children and Family Services (203 drop-off locations, 1,880 kiosks and cabinets), Monroe County, New York (550 naloxone boxes), the California prison system, and numerous county health departments across New York, Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Illinois, and other states.

The business originated to address allergy emergencies in schools and later expanded into overdose harm reduction. Wilson states that the company invests heavily in capacity, develops new products monthly based on customer requests, and offers custom product design. It operates a website dedicated to non-profit agencies that does not charge sales tax and maintains government registrations (CAGE/UEI) for public procurement.
